tool: OpenAI image generation product; every PNG carries a C2PA content-credentials manifest (PNG caBX chunk) signed by OpenAI
model: gpt-image 2.0 (softwareAgent name and version read from the embedded C2PA manifest; claim generator OpenAI Media Service API)

contentCredentials.standard: C2PA 2.2 manifest embedded in each file (PNG caBX chunk)
contentCredentials.signer: OpenAI OpCo, LLC (OpenAI Media Service certificate)
contentCredentials.verified: Chunk structure, agent name and version, claim generator, actions, signer and time-stamp authority tokens read from every file by scripts/lib/png.mjs and checked by the rasters validator at every run; the first set was countersigned on 2026-09-15 between 04:36 and 04:37 UTC, the slides-v2 set on 2026-09-15 between 19:13 and 19:19 UTC (the per-file timestamp is recorded on each entry)

operator: Universal Profiles design-system maintainer (role; no personal name is recorded)
generatedAt: 2026-09-14T21:36:00-07:00 (heroes and title pair, set 1); 2026-09-15T12:13:10-07:00 to 12:19:17-07:00 (slides-v2, set 2); the time-stamp authority token of each file is recorded on its entry
license: Apache-2.0 with the repository, to the extent copyright subsists in machine-generated images (see LICENSES/GENERATED-IMAGES.md); use remains subject to the generation product's terms; no warranty of exclusivity
rightsNote: Original AI-generated project output. Use remains subject to the repository license, trademark guidance, and applicable OpenAI terms.
postProcessing: None. Files are the generator's native output (1672x941, with two slides-v2 files at 1671x941), 8-bit RGB without an alpha channel, with the C2PA manifest left intact. The briefs list larger delivery formats (IB-02: a 16:9 master with 2560x1440, 1440x2560 and 1200x630 crops; IB-10 and IB-12: 1920x1080, 1080x1080 and 1080x1920), which have not been produced and are recorded as such in imagery/briefs.md.

slides-v2.promptSource: backgrounds/slides-v2/PROMPTS.source.json (the staged prompt file; every prompt below is byte-identical to it and the validator checks the two against each other)
slides-v2.use: Presentation backgrounds in six families, each in a light and a dark register; contact sheets in assets/slides/previews
slides-v2.requestedBy: The product owner asked on 2026-09-15 for these backgrounds to be visible in the repository and for further variations (decision 0011)

contract.description: The slide contract every generated background and hero must meet; checked by node scripts/validate.mjs --only rasters and documented in assets/generated/backgrounds/README.md
contract.contentCredentials: C2PA manifest (PNG caBX chunk) naming the software agent, present and intact
contract.pairs: every family has a -light and a -dark file
contract.safeZone: declared per file as fractions of the width and height; the validator measures it

lightRegister.note: mean luminance of the safe zone, 0 to 255; ink text stays legible

darkRegister.note: mean luminance of the safe zone, 0 to 255; white text stays legible

contract.maxSafeZoneDeviationNote: standard deviation of the safe-zone luminance; keeps the copy area quiet
